mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO group_agents (group_id, agent_id) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{agentId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS agent_id, a.name, a.avatar_url FROM group_agents ga JOIN agents a ON a.id = ga.agent_id WHERE ga.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY a.name
SELECT agent_id FROM group_agents WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT group_id FROM group_agents WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_agents WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
